test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

At loggerheads
solution:
The correct answer is 'Disagreeing with'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• At loggerheads is an idiom that means that **i****f two people or groups are at loggerheads, they disagree strongly about something.**

 
 
• ​Example - *He is **at loggerheads** with the Prime Minister over public spending.*
 
 
 
• So, disagreeing with is the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.
 
• Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.
